newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF Sakakibara to speak for an hour from 0830 GMT.
newsitem.headline: MOF Sakakibara to speak for an hour from 0830 GMT.

text.p: Senior Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara will speak at a meeting hosted by a political body in Tokyo on Thursday afternoon, a spokeswoman for the body said.
The meeting, hosted by the Jiyu Seikei Forum and to be attended by business executives, is due to start at 5.30 p.m. (0830 GMT) and last for about an hour, she said.

A spokesman for the forum said earlier this week that Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, planned to speak about a book he published recently, but may also refer to the currency market.
